_why: The single definition of what a valid background plate is. Read by apps/web/src/design/plateBinaries.test.ts, which enforces it on committed bytes, and by scripts/make-plate.mjs, which must not produce a plate the gate would reject. It was duplicated in both places until ChatGPT's standards review of PR #982 found the two copies had already diverged on day one: the gate allowed four geometries and the generator knew two, while calling itself a restatement of the gate.
_producerNote: A producer may support fewer geometries than the gate accepts; that is a producer limitation, not a narrowing of the contract, and it belongs in the producer rather than here.
